title: Recipe 58 — Safe production ops (eval-gated canaries and the SLO block)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Shipping an agent is shipping a model's behaviour. A percentage-based canary is not enough — the gate has to be an eval.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — the sentinel eval makes real calls.

groups.title: Beat 1 · the spec that declares its own SLO

beats.label: Type the recipe's spec
beats.cue: “An observability.slo block: time-to-first-token, error rate, cost per turn. Budgets, in the spec, in the diff.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Clean. An SLO you declare is an SLO the tooling can check for you.”

beats.label: Compile it and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN, gated at the model credential.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Check the SLO
beats.cue: “doctor --slo exits 0 within budget. On a harness with no traffic yet it tells you which budgets are undeclared rather than passing silently.”

verify.note: reports per-budget status; undeclared budgets are named, not skipped

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “This is the command a deploy pipeline calls. Exit code is the gate.”

beats.label: Score the MCP servers
beats.cue: “mcp doctor scores every server from real call history — the flaky one shows up before it takes a canary down.”

verify.note: no MCP call history yet — reports that plainly

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “Another diagnostic that admits when it has no data instead of guessing.”

beats.label: Read the canary contract
beats.cue: “--traffic 5,25,50,100 with an eval gate at each step. A step that regresses rolls back instead of advancing.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “The gate is the point. Traffic percentages without a gate are just a slower outage.”

beats.label: Read the incident contract
beats.cue: “incident collect bundles the session, the spec, and the eval deltas into one artifact — so the postmortem starts with evidence.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “--kind regression --reason 'canary rollback at 25%'. Write the reason while you still remember it.”

groups.title: One more thing · the nightly loop

beats.label: Run the sentinel eval
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Nightly: eval --sentinel catches the provider changing under you — the regression nobody deployed.”

verify.note: needs a registered dataset and a model credential; billed

beats.label: Read the schedule
beats.cue: “Nightly sentinel, per-deploy canary, on-call doctor. Three cadences, three different failures caught.”
